in_hebrew.name: אֵלִיעוֹת
in_hebrew.long_meaning: הַשֵּם אֵלִיעוֹת צוֹרַף מִן הַשְּׁאֵל, כַּעֲקָרָה שֶׁל עֵץ. בְּטֶרֶם יִקָּרֵא אֵלִיעוֹת, נִקְרָא אֵלִי, כְּבָסֵלָה שֶׁל עֵץ. עֵץ שֶׁלְ עֵץ, תּוֹצֵא, כְּדֶרֶךְ תּוֹצֵא הָעֵץ, כְּטִמְבּוּר אֵלִי.

in_latin.name: Eliot
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Eliot, a Latinized form of the Hebrew name El'iyot, meaning 'my God is with me.' In the Christian tradition, Eliot is associated with the saint Saint Eliot, a 3rd-century Christian martyr. The name Eliot has been used in various forms throughout history, including Eliot, Elioth, and Elloit.
